title: Grading the network: How MQA and dynamic level-of-service engines are replacing the budget spreadsheet
summary: A statewide transportation authority replaced its failing spreadsheet model with a cloud-native Asset Management System. Using dynamic Level-of-Service (LOS) budgeting, the agency objectively justified a 33% budget increase—from $162M to $216M—backed by hard performance data.
